newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-TONGA OVERPOWERED 46-6 BY NORTH WEST.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TONGA OVERPOWERED 46-6 BY NORTH WEST.

text.p: Tonga slumped to the first defeat of their Southern African tour when they were overpowered 46-6 by North West in icy conditions at Olen Park on Wednesday.
The Tongans, with wins over Zimbabwe and Namibia in their four victories in the past two weeks, failed to adapt to both the harsh winter weather and the sheer size of their opposing forwards.
North West (formerly Western Transvaal) ran in seven tries and were effectively marshalled by former Transvaal scrum-half Jopie Adlam, fresh from his Super 12 campaign with the Gauteng Lions.
Tonga face Eastern Province on Sunday and Border next Wednesday before their one-off test against South Africa in Cape Town on June 10.

North West: Tony Lincoln; Rudi Muller (Johan van der Berg 65 min), A.J. de Jager, Jans van Wyk, Charl Bensch (Reagan Anderson 55 min); Bertus Kruger, Jopie Adlam; Chris Oosthuizen, Markus van Greunen (captain), Bertus Pool (Kurt Steinbach 69 min), Andew Duckitt, Kleinjan Tromp, Tenk Hendriks, Leon Boshoff, Hannes Human.

Tonga: Gustavo Tonga; Semisi Faka'osifolau, Fepi Tatafu (Siua Taumalolo 76 min), Viliami Uhi, Tevita Manako (Etuate Manu 70 min); Simana Mafileo (Tevita 'Alatini 39 min), Manu Vunipola; Ronald Katoa (captain), Sione Tohi, Maama Molitika (Kuli Faletau 2 min), Saia Moala (Kilioni Tu'ipulotu 40 min), 'Alipate Ta'ufo'ou, Heamani Lavaka, Fe'ao Vunipola, Ngalu Tau.
